title: dispatch
description: Input schema for the lernie built-in `dispatch` tool (ARCH §2.5, §3.3, §3.4 — v0.4 Phase 2). The harness sends this verbatim as the `input_schema` field of the tool's entry in the model call's `tools: [...]` array.

role.description: Subagent role to dispatch. Must resolve to <conv-repo>/souls/<role>.md and be present in the per-repo providers.yaml `roles:` block (ARCH §4.3). v0.4 Phase 2 supports `worker`; future roles slot in by name as the dispatch CLI grows.

goal.description: Per-call goal text. Written verbatim to the subagent's goal.md on its dispatch commit (ARCH §2.3 step 2 / §2.8). The subagent reads its goal there; the dispatching agent does not see the subagent's intermediate work — only the terminal compacted result, which returns later as a message deposited into the parent's inbox (ARCH §2.11).

name.description: Display name for the child (ARCH §2.3): one unbroken word, unique among the workspace's living agents, set here and never rewritten. A name is the child's identity in every surface — it is stored under the child, told to the child itself, and is what `message` accepts in place of the child's agent id — so supplying one keeps the identities and tasks in a subagent tree clear; pick a name that says what the child is for. If you omit it, a valid one-word name is minted automatically, so an unnamed dispatch is never an error — but a name you supply that is malformed, begins like an agent id, or is already worn by a living agent is refused and no child is created.
